_comment: Role-based learning paths. Each step points at a track (topic id) and optionally limits it to some levels or specific lesson slugs. Validated by scripts/build.js.

paths.title: Frontend Developer
paths.summary: From your first HTML page to building, testing and shipping production React apps — with the browser, HTTP and performance knowledge interviewers probe.

steps.why: Semantic structure, forms and accessibility are the foundation of every UI.
Box model, Flexbox, Grid and responsive design.
The language itself: closures, this, async and the event loop.
Every team expects branching, PRs and resolving conflicts.
Typed JavaScript is the default in modern frontend teams.
Components, hooks, state management, performance and React 19 / Next.js.
HTTP, REST, CORS, cookies and authentication from the browser's side.
Unit tests with Testing Library and E2E tests with Playwright/Cypress.
Build and test a real SPA.
Polyfills, memory and output puzzles asked in senior rounds.
Critical rendering path, Core Web Vitals and web components.
XSS, CSRF, CSP and HTTP/2-3 for security and performance questions.
Optional: many enterprise roles ask for Angular.
Coding rounds still happen for frontend roles.
Frontend system design: caching, CDNs, APIs.

paths.title: Full-Stack JavaScript (React + Node)
paths.summary: One language across the stack: React frontends, Node.js APIs, PostgreSQL, auth, Docker and CI/CD — ending with a deployed full-stack product.

steps.why: Master the language end to end — it powers both sides.
Shared types between client and server.
HTTP, REST, CORS, sessions vs JWT, OAuth.
Express APIs, event loop, streams, auth and databases from Node.
Build a tested REST API (choose the Node.js option).
API and E2E tests for your app.
Scaling, workers, queues and production readiness.
Isolation, query plans, Redis and scaling.

paths.title: Python Backend Developer
paths.summary: Python from basics to internals, then FastAPI and Django APIs, databases, Linux, Docker and cloud deployment.

steps.why: Core language, OOP, decorators, generators and testing.
Servers, processes, systemd and shell scripting.
Modern async APIs with Pydantic and dependency injection.
Build and test an API (FastAPI option).
The batteries-included framework, DRF and the ORM.
Full product with auth and Docker.
Isolation levels, optimisation, Redis and NoSQL.
Deploy to the cloud (or choose Azure/GCP).

paths.title: Enterprise Full-Stack (Angular + Java / .NET)
paths.summary: The classic enterprise stack: TypeScript and Angular on the front, Spring Boot or ASP.NET Core on the back, relational databases, and deployment to Kubernetes/OpenShift.

steps.why: Components, DI, RxJS, Signals, forms, routing and change detection.
Core Java, JVM, Spring Boot, JPA and Spring Security.
Optional alternative backend: C#, ASP.NET Core and EF Core.
Build it with Angular + Spring Boot (or ASP.NET Core).

paths.title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
paths.summary: Linux, Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform and AWS/Azure/GCP — ending with GitOps deployments and cloud infrastructure as code.

steps.why: Git internals, workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
HTTP, DNS, TLS, caching — needed to debug anything.
Enterprise Kubernetes: SCCs, Routes, Operators, Pipelines, GitOps.
Optional third cloud and the cross-cloud mapping table.
Infrastructure as code, state, modules and pipelines.
Provision a full environment as code.

paths.title: QA / SDET (Test Automation Engineer)
paths.summary: Testing fundamentals and test design, then automation with Playwright, Cypress and Selenium, API and performance testing, CI integration and a full framework project.

steps.why: Testing principles, levels, types, test design and defect management.
HTTP and APIs for API testing.
Unit, API and E2E automation, frameworks, CI and flaky tests.
Build a complete framework with reports in CI.
Performance, security, metrics and test strategy.
Run apps and test infrastructure in containers.
Optional: Selenium + Java stacks are common.

paths.title: RPA Developer
paths.summary: Process analysis, UiPath/Power Automate development, REFramework, Orchestrator, document processing and agentic automation — plus the data and testing skills around them.

steps.why: What RPA is, platforms and the project lifecycle.
Bots read and write business data.
Scripting for custom activities and Robocorp.
Selectors, REFramework, Orchestrator, queues and data handling.
Exceptions, governance, Power Automate, AA/Blue Prism, agentic automation.
APIs instead of UI where possible.
LLMs and agents are reshaping automation.

paths.title: AI Engineer
paths.summary: Python, ML fundamentals, LLMs, RAG, agents and MCP — served through FastAPI, evaluated properly and deployed with Docker and the cloud.

steps.why: ML workflow, metrics, neural networks, Transformers and MLOps.
LLMs, prompting, embeddings, RAG, fine-tuning, agents, evaluation and safety.
Serve models and LLM apps as APIs.
Streaming, auth and security for AI apps.

paths.title: 2-Week Interview Sprint
paths.summary: Already know your stack? Revise the most-asked fundamentals fast: JavaScript internals, HTTP & security, SQL, system design and coding patterns, then practise with flashcards.

steps.why: Closures, this, event loop, polyfills, output questions.
